rows.en: Who's gonna play with me~?
Fufufu... That Dopant over there. The Dummy Dopant will play with you, hm?
Huh? This guy? Yaaay! Mister Dopant, I'm borrowing your body!
H-hey, what are you doing!! S-somebody help me!!
...U-Ugyaaaaaaaaaaah!!
It worked...!! Behold the birth of the ultimate fusion kaijin, Ultimate Dopant!!
So you really mean to crucify us on those crosses from before...
So this is... Ultimate Dopant!?
Tch! One thing after another... You sure came prepared!!
So you really mean to crucify us on those crosses from before...
So you really mean to crucify us on those crosses from before...
No matter who you send, you're 20,000 years too early to beat me!!
So you really mean to crucify us on those crosses from before...
So this is... Ultimate Dopant!?
So this is... Ultimate Dopant!?
So this is... Ultimate Dopant!?
So this is... Ultimate Dopant!?
Target confirmed... Eliminating it!!
Target confirmed... Destroying it.
Fufufufu... Mebius Killer and Ultimate Dopant...
Both are ultimate soldiers born of our research, made to bury you once and for all!!
Im...possible... There's no way... you could defeat me...
My vengeful spirit will have its revenge...! I will await you in a future of ruin...!!
Yapool... What a vengeful enemy...
Yapool... You were one tough opponent...
Yapool... He was a formidable foe...
Yapool... He was a formidable foe...
Yapool... He was a formidable foe...
Yapool... He was a formidable foe...
Yapool... What a stubborn bastard that guy was...
Yapool... He was a formidable foe...
Yapool... He was a formidable foe...
Yapool... He was a formidable foe...
Yapool... He was a formidable foe...
Yapool... He was a formidable foe...
Yapool... He was a formidable foe...
Hey, look at that!
That's an Ultra Sign!! "SOS"... Who could be sending it!?
That's an Ultra Sign!! "SOS"... Who the heck is sending it!?
That's the Ultra Sign for "SOS"! But who could have sent that sign!!
That's the Ultra Sign for "SOS"! But who could have sent that sign!!
An Ultra Sign!? There must be other Ultra Warriors up ahead.
An Ultra Sign!? There must be other Ultra Warriors out there!
Can't read what the hell it says, but you're tellin' me there's more Ultra Warriors up ahead?
An Ultra Sign!? Looks like there are other Ultra Warriors up ahead.
I can't tell what it says, but there must be other Ultra Warriors out there, right?
An Ultra Sign!? There must be other Ultra Warriors out there!
An Ultra Sign!? There must be other Ultra Warriors out there!
So that's an Ultra Sign... Meaning there are other Ultra Warriors.
So that's an Ultra Sign... Meaning there are other Ultra Warriors.
The heroes returned to their base to work out their next move.
Yapool... Even so, you made the heroes suffer greatly.
Your fight was not in vain.
...We confirmed the Ultra Sign here as well. It seems to have been sent from Cube 4.
There are Ultra Warriors in Cube 4 too?
Yes... The Land of Light has been absorbed into that Cube.
However, the shapes and layout of its facilities differ from the real Land of Light.
It doesn't seem to have been faithfully reconstructed.
...You know a lot about it, huh?
The truth is, Cube 4 is where I awoke.
What? Then how did you end up...
Having lost my power, I was defeated by the enemy and taken to Cube 3...
So that's what happened. Then if there are other Ultra Warriors there too, that's...
Yes... not surprising at all.
We've got to go help them.
But wait. Unless we can break through that wall...
You can get through, you know.
I've fitted the Ride Machine with the Zeroliner Drill.
Hikari...!
Impressive as ever.
As an engineer, I only did what was expected of me.
Well? What are you standing around for? Get going!!
The Ride Machine's drill was replaced with the Zeroliner Drill.
I-Impossible... that I... But remember this.
We of Regis have absorbed every "power" there is, from every world.
Even the "power" you lost is in our hands. You cannot possibly win now...
Then we'll just take the "power" back! We will never forgive evil like you!
Then we'll just take the "power" back! We will never forgive evil like you!
Then we'll just take the "power" back! We will never forgive evil like you!

notes.note: #0.90-#0.98 are not played by 0359.bla (script jumps +88 -> +98+12); unused alternate scene, translated anyway. Speakers inferred: #0.92/#0.94 Neo-Organism (childlike; in Movie War 2010 the Neo-Organism fuses with Dopants into Ultimate D, matching story_060 'evolved form of that Dummy Dopant'), #0.93/#0.98 Ikadevil (commands the Neo-Organism in story_054/055), #0.95-#0.96 Dummy Dopant. Not Ryutaros despite the 'borrow your body' wording.

#0.99-#0.111 leader variants. Wording does not fit the 0359 chain used by the other blocks (Mebius would get 'ore-tachi' and Black RX Zero's catchphrase), so voiced by wording: #0.101 rough (Momotaros-type), #0.104 Zero, #0.110 Setsuna ('kuchiku'), #0.111 Heero. The ore/watashi/boku-tachi 'cross' variants share one English line. Retort to Yapool, so 'you' (Yapool) restored as subject; 'crosses' = the crucifixion crosses in story_063.
Sentence subject restored: 'Both' = Mebius Killer and Ultimate D.
#0.118-#0.119 Yapool's alternate defeat lines; not referenced by 0359.bla (the played defeat lines are #0.180-#0.182). Speaker inferred.

#0.120-#0.132 leader variants in the 0359 chain order (Mebius, Zero, Ultraman, Seven, Rider 1, RX, Den-O, W, OOO, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00): #0.121 Zero ('ze'), #0.126 Momotaros ('yarou'). Same order fits #0.135-#0.147 (#0.141 Momotaros, #0.143 OOO polite) and #0.183-#0.185.
Ultra Sign: Ultraman franchise term (sky-writing signal), not in glossary. The Japanese quotes around SOS kept as double quotes.
Speaker '???' (CHARA_NAME 30): an unnamed Regis figure addressing the dead Yapool.

#0.154-#0.173 base scene, not played by 0359.bla and unlabelled. Speakers inferred: Zoffy (commander at base since story_064) says #0.154, #0.156-#0.158, #0.160, #0.162, #0.164, #0.166 ('matte' imperative), #0.170; Hikari (repairing the drill in story_064) says #0.167-#0.168, #0.171 (polite to Zoffy) and probably #0.172; #0.155/#0.159/#0.161/#0.163/#0.165/#0.169 a hero. #0.162 'taken to Cube 3' matches Zoffy's rescue from the cross in Cube 3. Zeroliner spelling per story_060.
Sentence runs into Zoffy's reply #0.164; cut at the matching point.
'ikeru ze' = the heroes can get through the wall now; subject 'you' restored (Hikari to the heroes, inferred).
Speaker uncertain (Hikari or Zoffy); wording works for either.
Quoted 'chikara' kept in quotes as "power", as in the source.
#0.183-#0.185 (Mebius boku-tachi, Zero ore-tachi, Ultraman wareware) differ only in the pronoun; one English line. Block continues in story_065 #0.186-#0.195.

report: 80/80 rows. #0.90-#0.98 (Neo-Organism/Ikadevil/Dummy Dopant fusion), #0.118-#0.119 and #0.154-#0.173 (Zoffy/Hikari base scene) are not played by 0359.bla; speakers inferred. #0.99-#0.111 leader block voiced by wording because it does not match the script's slot order. #0.172 speaker uncertain (Hikari or Zoffy). Terms not in glossary: Ultra Sign, Zeroliner Drill (spelling from story_060), Cube 3/Cube 4.
